items.source:
Holder for the result of a match on the start of a pattern.
Provides access to the remaining path not matched to the pattern as well
as any variables bound in that first part that was matched.
items.translation: 匹配模式开头部分的结果持有器。它提供对未与模式匹配的剩余路径的访问，以及在该已匹配的第一部分中绑定的任何变量。

items.source: Return the path parameters for each bound variable.
items.translation: 返回每个绑定变量的路径参数。

items.source: Return the part of a path that was matched by a pattern.
items.translation: 返回由模式匹配的路径部分。

items.source: Return the part of a path that was not matched by a pattern.
items.translation: 返回路径中未被模式匹配的部分。

items.source:
Return variables that were bound in the part of the path that was
successfully matched or an empty map.
items.translation: 返回在成功匹配的路径部分中绑定的变量，或返回一个空映射。
